sections.title: Communication & Social Interaction
sections.subtitle: Questions about how you communicate and interact with others

questions.text: Do you find it difficult to start or maintain conversations?
Do you find it hard to understand jokes, sarcasm, or figurative language?
Do you prefer routines and find it distressing when plans change unexpectedly?
How comfortable are you in social gatherings with unfamiliar people?
Do you have difficulty understanding the emotions or perspectives of others?

sections.title: Sensory & Behavioural
sections.subtitle: Questions about sensory experiences and repetitive behaviours

questions.text: Are you unusually sensitive to sounds, lights, textures, or smells?
Do you engage in repetitive behaviours or movements when stressed or excited?
Do you have strong, specific interests that you focus on intensely?
How much does sensory sensitivity affect your daily life?

sections.title: Daily Living & Independence
sections.subtitle: Questions about managing daily tasks and independence

questions.text: Are you able to manage daily tasks (cooking, cleaning, personal hygiene) independently?
Are you currently employed or engaged in a vocational activity?
How many hours per day do you sleep on average?
Describe the main challenges you face in your daily life.
What support do you currently receive (therapy, community services, family)?
Do you experience anxiety in social or unfamiliar situations?
Do you experience periods of low mood or depression?
How would you rate your overall quality of life?
What are your personal goals and what support would help you achieve them?
